tree.heading: Board.—
tree.text: The term “Board” means the Preservation Technology and Training Board established pursuant to section 305303 of this title.

tree.heading: Center.—
tree.text: The term “Center” means the National Center for Preservation Technology and Training established pursuant to section 305302 of this title.
